fixed_setting.stimulus: Retain ten historical states at recorded electrical a/x fractions; include manual endpoints with IN=CV=0

paired_CV.allowed_adjustments: None within sweep; difference or fitted slope is diagnostic only, no output correction or calibration coefficients applied
paired_CV.held_controls: Set and record ATTEN/OFFSET once; no changes across paired readings; actual reference/rails/temp and load unchanged
paired_CV.load: Propose10kohm fixed throughout slope/intercept measurement; no mixing open andloaded points
paired_CV.metric: Gain=(OUT(+5)−OUT(−5))/(CV(+5)−CV(−5)); report intercept/OUT0 and each raw residual separately. Constant intercept cancels only to extent stable; pairedspan error not a2mV absolute acceptance test
paired_CV.reference: Independent traceable external voltage readings, not on-boardREF5 or nominal pot fraction; record OUT0 separately
paired_CV.stimulus: IN=0; external OFFSET_CV sweep−5,0,+5V measured atjack, using same source impedance

same_setting_load.allowed_adjustments: None between paired loads; do not rezero or change stimulus to restore target output after load changes
same_setting_load.held_controls: Hold inputs, ATTEN/OFFSET, calibrationstate, rails/temp/reference and groundconnection unchanged within each pair; record settling
same_setting_load.load: Open→10kohm ascanonical; record actual resistance and instrument loading
same_setting_load.metric: OUT10k−OUTopen at same setting; retain distinct1mV target, not summed into or replaced by calibrated2mV target
same_setting_load.reference: Same external meter/referenceplane for both readings; open means documented instrument load
same_setting_load.stimulus: Establish nominal−5,0,+5V output test states using declared input/control setup, then alternate open and10kohm atOUT_TIP
